final: SELECT actor_id, COUNT(*) AS film_actor_record_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(actor_count) FROM (SELECT actor_id, COUNT(*) AS actor_count FROM film_actor GROUP BY actor_id)) AS actor_share, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(actor_count) FROM (SELECT actor_id, COUNT(*) AS actor_count FROM film_actor GROUP BY actor_id)) - (SELECT AVG(actor_share) FROM (SELECT actor_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(actor_count) FROM (SELECT actor_id, COUNT(*) AS actor_count FROM film_actor GROUP BY actor_id)) AS actor_share FROM (SELECT actor_id, COUNT(*) AS actor_count FROM film_actor GROUP BY actor_id))) AS share_minus_average FROM film_actor GROUP BY actor_id ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC LIMIT 10
